statement.essentials: Most lumps that grow in the parotid are benign, and the most common is a pleomorphic adenoma.
statement.anatomy: Pleomorphic adenoma forms the largest group of salivary gland tumours at most sites, and is particularly common in the parotid.
statement.clinical: In a series of 2,410 salivary gland tumours the parotid was the principal site and pleomorphic adenomas were the largest group, particularly common in the parotid. Of 84 consecutive parotid tumours examined by MRI, 68% were benign, and 29 were pleomorphic adenomas.

numbers.label: Benign among parotid tumours
numbers.population: Consecutive patients with a parotid tumour who had MRI before surgery, one centre

limitations: Series from specialist centres; the share of benign tumours differs between studies (a single imaging cohort here).
